data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hosea means 'Jehovah saves'. In the Old Testament, Hosea is the name of a prophet whose writings were included in the Book of Hosea. He is considered one of the twelve minor prophets. The name Hosea carries the meaning “Jehovah saves” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hosea usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah saves and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hosea holds significant cultural impact, particularly in the Jewish and Christian traditions. Hosea is revered as a prophet in Judaism and Christianity, and his writings have had a significant influence on Jewish and Christian thought and belief. The name Hosea is also used in modern times as a given name for boys in these traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Hosea lies in its meaning, 'Jehovah saves'. In the Old Testament book bearing his name, Hosea embodies God's love and mercy towards His people, as well as God's faithfulness even in the face of Israel's repeated unfaithfulness. The name Hosea serves as a reminder of God's saving grace and forgiveness for all people. In Christianity, Hosea is also seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus, the ultimate savior.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hosea denotes loving devotion and compassion, as this prophet was commanded by God to marry a promiscuous woman, demonstrating God's unwavering love for his people despite their waywardness.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Hosea is most commonly recognized as that of a biblical prophet and ancient historical figure. In modern contexts, Hosea is often studied and discussed in religious studies and theology classes, particularly in reference to his messianic prophecies and the broader context of the Hebrew Bible. Hosea is also a popular name in contemporary Christian music and art, where it is often used as a symbol of God's love and faithfulness, as well as a reminder of the biblical story of Hosea and his wife Gomer. Hosea is also referenced in various biblical apps and websites, which provide users with access to the text of the book of Hosea and related resources for study and reflection. In the Christian media and entertainment industries, Hosea is featured in sermons, devotionals, and other religious content, as well as in films, TV shows, and other works of art that explore the themes and stories of the Bible.
